title: Machine learning predicts progression of sepsis-associated kidney injury
summary: Six machine learning algorithms were trained on MIMIC-IV to predict progression of sepsis-associated AKI to stage 3 within seven days. The random forest reached an AUC of 0.779 in MIMIC-IV and 0.758 in temporal validation, with external validation in eICU-CRD (10,332 patients) and SICdb (1,701). The data are retrospective and discrimination is modest.
ai_technology: Random forest with Lasso/RFE feature selection and SHAP
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University

evidence.tested: Prediction of AKI progression with temporal and external database validation.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; modest AUC; clinical benefit not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Random forest model predicting AKI stage progression.
